definitions.explanation: A polite way to refer to a Japanese-style room with tatami flooring, especially one used for entertaining guests.

definitions.gloss: banquet with geisha entertainment; being called to entertain
definitions.explanation: A banquet or gathering in a tatami room where geisha perform. By extension, also refers to an invitation or booking for a geisha to attend an event.

examples.japanese: お{座敷|ざしき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦どうぞ→どうぞ：02920_douzo⟧。
examples.english: Please come into the tatami room.

examples.japanese: お{座敷|ざしき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|とお}されて→通す：02300_toosu⟧、⟦お{茶|ちゃ}→お茶：00576_ocha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}された→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: I was shown to the tatami room and served tea.

examples.japanese: ⟦{立派|りっぱ}→立派：01093_rippa⟧なお{座敷|ざしき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{泊|と}まった→泊まる：10445_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: I stayed at an inn with a magnificent tatami room.

examples.japanese: お{座敷|ざしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: To receive a booking (for geisha entertainment).

examples.japanese: ⟦{舞妓|まいこ}→舞妓：15099_maiko⟧さん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{座敷|ざしき}⟦{遊|あそ}び→遊び：01285_asobi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{体験|たいけん}した→体験する：09858_taikensuru⟧。
examples.english: I experienced a banquet with maiko entertainment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧お{座敷|ざしき}⟦{遊|あそ}び→遊び：01285_asobi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦プラン→プラン：00345_puran⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: In Kyoto, there are plans that allow even tourists to enjoy a geisha banquet experience.

notes:
REGISTER:
The お prefix makes this a polite form of ⟦{座敷|ざしき}→座敷：00433_zashiki⟧. Both forms are used, but お{座敷|ざしき} is more common in hospitality contexts.

CULTURAL NOTE:
In sense 2, お{座敷|ざしき} refers to the traditional world of geisha entertainment. お{座敷|ざしき}⟦{遊|あそ}び→遊び：01285_asobi⟧ includes games, conversation, dance performances, and music by geisha or maiko in a private tatami room setting. This is a key part of Kyoto's traditional culture.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{座敷|ざしき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧ (to enter the tatami room)
- お{座敷|ざしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧ (to receive a geisha booking)
- お{座敷|ざしき}⟦{遊|あそ}び→遊び：01285_asobi⟧ (geisha banquet entertainment)
- お{座敷|ざしき}⟦{芸|げい}→芸：19343_gei⟧ (geisha performing arts)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{座敷|ざしき}→座敷：00433_zashiki⟧: tatami room — without the polite お prefix
- ⟦{和室|わしつ}→和室：10437_washitsu⟧: Japanese-style room — the standard modern term for a tatami room
